verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test environment for Zoho Books, nor any dry-run or isolated test mode. The API endpoints for creating an organization and copying settings to one would at most let a user build a separate test organization themselves. That is a workaround built from developer primitives, not a first-party sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
